fixture_description: P076 stale lock where liveness was checked using PID alone without process_start_time, creating a PID reuse vulnerability. Proves all required identity fields must be checked.
hold_condition_triggered: Stale-lock recovery can allow two writers to proceed or lacks PID-reuse-resistant liveness checks
risk: A process with the same PID as the previous holder could be incorrectly identified as the same lock holder, allowing two concurrent writers.
